text:
Maria Gonzalez: Quick check — just uploaded a lightweight handoff matrix for the SI consortium + marketplace/hardware leads: https://confluence.redwood.ai/si-consortium-handoff (pls use the 'Consortium v1' tab). Can folks skim and call out any deal-edge rules?

Kevin Chen: skimmed. main ask: confirm the origination -> credit rule. Current draft says 'SI-originated leads get primary credit unless account is on Enterprise Carve list'. that seems fine but we need an explicit TTL for 'warm handoff' claims (i.e., how long SI retains claim after handoff). recommend 30 days.

Olivia Parker: +1 on 30d for warm handoffs. also we need SKU-level mapping for hardware partners — some vendors want credit only if the HW SKU is included in the contract. suggest adding a column: "SKU scope: yes/no" and a short example row.

Kevin Chen: agreed. example row suggestion:
```
Account: Acme Corp
Lead origin: SI - Northstar
Claim window: 30d
SKU scope: Yes - includes GPUTier-A
Routing: Partner PM -> Redwood AE -> SI COSELL tag
```

Maria Gonzalez: perfect. also calling out joint announcement rules: public joint announcements require Legal + PMM signoff and a partner comms plan; internal-only wins can be posted by AE + SI with a 3-person notify list. added a checklist to the doc.

Olivia Parker: small process ask — if an SI is pursuing cloud marketplace listing and the same account wants a demo, which team owns the demo cadence? my proposal: Marketplace pursuit team owns listing cadence, SI owns live demo if they introduced the account during the claim window. if Redwood AE introduces the account post-listing, AE owns the demo. thoughts?

Kevin Chen: that flows OK. maybe add a quick flowchart in the doc. I can sketch and drop it later today.

partnerships-bot: Automated note: matrix v1 uploaded by Maria G at 2024-06-18 14:02 UTC. Change log: added "Claim window" and "SKU scope" columns.

Maria Gonzalez: thanks @Kevin @Olivia — if nobody objects by EOD PST I'll mark this as 'Consortium v1 - agreed' and run a short sync with the SI PMs tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Olivia Parker: no objections from me. :+1:

Kevin Chen: fine from my side. go ahead. :rocket:
